verdict.rationale: Swell's evidence covers catalog management, CSV import/export, custom models, and webhooks/APIs for building integrations, but there is no mention of built-in or official connectors for marketplaces (Amazon, eBay), social commerce (Instagram/Facebook Shop), or shopping feeds (Google Shopping). Webhooks and APIs could theoretically be used to build such sync, but no evidence shows this capability shipped or documented as a channel-sync feature.
